items.title: Corrected residue profiles for five gene–disease pairs
assumptions: All gnomAD carriers are treated as unaffected.

source.label: Corrected missense residue tables

metricDefinitions.label: Residue density
metricDefinitions.definition: Residue density is the mean of supported variant-only leave-one-out posterior neighborhood scores at each canonical residue.

filters: Observed canonical missense variants, including population-only variants.
Gene-specific missense empirical priors fitted separately from nonsense.
Positive sigmoid distance kernel with half weight at 3 Å.
Polymer distances restricted to the same candidate disordered segment and chain.
caveats: The plotted band is the between-variant range, not a confidence interval.
Source corrections are bounded; these features are not calibrated disease probabilities.

evidenceFlow.title: Numerical and figure checks
evidenceFlow.detail: Independent checks reproduce 10 priors, 67 primary weight shards and all 6,050 residue rows. All six PNGs were visually reviewed; clipped labels and hidden small positive values were corrected.

preview.note: One summary row per gene; underlying per-residue data are linked in the report.

items.title: Why low-case regions retain positive posterior density

source.label: Prior and distance diagnostics

metricDefinitions.label: Prior contribution
metricDefinitions.definition: The posterior neighborhood averages each donor’s count-updated empirical posterior, so zero affected observations can still contribute a positive prior component.

caveats: A raw observed-fraction score and a posterior-neighborhood score have different meanings.
Sparse zero-case evidence does not establish a disease probability below 0.1%.

queries.summary: BRCA2’s median weight beyond 20 Å is 0.474%, while 40 supported targets have no affected donor and exactly zero raw-fraction score. GCK’s unaffected-singleton posterior remains 25.78% under its empirical prior.

methods.code:
Own posterior = (alpha_empirical + affected) / (alpha_empirical + beta_empirical + affected + unaffected)
For GCK A=0, U=1: 1.0268273749182273 / (2.982971890149705 + 1) = 0.2578043238160118
